name: heimdall-vscode
description: C++ diagnostics, quick fixes, formatting, and code completion powered by Heimdall.

commandPalette.when: editorLangId == c || editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == cuda || editorLangId == objective-c || editorLangId == objective-cpp

heimdall.serverPath.description: Path to the heimdall-lsp executable. When left as the default, the extension uses the versioned install from GitHub releases, then workspace build output, then PATH.

heimdall.serverVersion.description: Heimdall release version to download (e.g. "0.3.1"). Empty means the extension's own version. Tags and release assets are named v<version> / heimdall-<platform>-<arch>.zip.

heimdall.autoInstallServer.description: Automatically download and install the matching heimdall-lsp from GitHub releases when no local server is found.

heimdall.trace.server.description: Trace JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and heimdall-lsp.

heimdall.enableSemantic.description: Enable simple local semantic diagnostics using compile_commands.json.

heimdall.workspaceDiagnostics.description: Lint every C++ file in the workspace in the background (not only open files), so the Problems panel shows the project-wide warning count.

heimdall.workspaceSymbols.description: Index the declarations of every C++ file in the workspace in the background so "Go to Symbol in Workspace" (Ctrl+T) finds them. The outline of the current file (Outline view, Ctrl+Shift+O) does not depend on this setting.

heimdall.compileCommands.description: Path to compile_commands.json, relative to the first workspace folder unless absolute.
